NAM.note: The link described is between the population register and social protection, not between a civil register and a separate ID system.
No count or share of people enrolled is given.
No unique number given at birth is stated.
No statement on who operates or maintains the system.

facts.fact: Namibia's two responsible ministries signed an agreement integrating the National Population Registration System with the social protection system to verify existence and live status of persons, and the Covid-19 Emergency Income Grant applicants were all verified against the NPRS.
Namibia's presentation says it is in the process of introducing an electronic identity card, expected to enhance security and authentication in digital services.
